summary: Implemented a deterministic, structured Phase Report View Composition layer (src/pcae/core/phase_report_view.py) over the verified phase_report_v1 Evidence Extraction result. Composition organizes extracted canonical evidence into all thirteen PFR-001 Phase Report sections via a fixed, explicit category-to-section map -- never heuristic text classification -- deciding section assignment, ordering, structured labels, phase-class-specific treatment, explicit not-applicable treatment, and structured completeness presentation. Not yet active lifecycle authority: only internal imports are evidence_extraction and three shared enums from canonical_engineering_evidence; otherwise stdlib-only, never consumed by the current governed reporting/finalization/notification path. Enforces Non-Omission via an assignment-accounting mechanism and Non-Strengthening via a completeness floor that never reports a better rank than the source extraction's own. Findings/repair history preserved in full (original BLOCKING classification alongside post-repair CONFIRMED status, never collapsed). Uncertainty, limitations, and filtering disclosures preserved at both per-section and report-level bundles. 88 new focused tests (all 86 required areas) pass; 928 combined regression tests (evidence model 134E.1/134E.1V, extraction 134E.2/134E.2V, phase-identity repair, phase_reports, finalization-gate, trust-hard-fail, certification-idempotency, 134B.1-134B.3, phase) pass unchanged; fast_green 4390/4390 passing this run. Repaired, as a pre-declared expected consequence of this phase's own scope (not a new defect), 134E.2V's own test_no_active_lifecycle_imports_fresh_scan, narrowing its zero-consumers assertion to admit this phase's own expected, still-isolated new consumer. Resolved the planning-phase evidence-scope observation directly (existing categories sufficient); left the other two 134E.2V observations open, unrepaired as instructed. Only Phase Report View Composition implemented -- Operator Report View Composition, rendering, delivery, and lifecycle integration are out of scope. 134E.3V not begun.
